cohort.selection: strongest recent 300 s scan by exported RF observation count, plus four other recent same-radio 2.5 MS/s scans; selected before fitting

protocol.partition: chronological first 60 percent training, final 40 percent held out
protocol.track_policy: all exported source-disjoint RF tracklets; RX paths scored as separate arcs
protocol.identity_policy: full causal Starlink catalogue with unassigned component; no fixed identities

limitations: single-scan acquisition is multimodal and changes across the three declared starting squares
receiver copies are separate source-balanced arcs; no paired-geometry independence claim is made
50 km global cells require identity-refreshing full-observation local refinement before a final position
geographic truth was unavailable to inference and is evaluated only after sealing
